Vol. 1 No. 81 (2026): Journal of the Kufa Studies Center, dated June 30, 2026

This is Issue No. 81 of the *Journal of the Kufa Studies Center*, dated June 30, 2026. It is the second issue of 2026 and contains 20 peer-reviewed research papers published by the Kufa Studies Center at the University of Kufa.
